subject: english-language-arts

location.unitTitle: Main Ideas, Text Structures, and Explanatory Writing

instructions: Read the supplied text or source closely, then write an original analysis or composition.
Cite relevant evidence and revise for meaning, organization, and language before submitting.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain main idea and supporting details in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of cause and effect.
Apply chronology in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving compare and contrast; correct it and explain why.
Connect main idea and supporting details with explanatory organization. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Create a clear illustrated or audio-supported explainer using evidence from two informational texts.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Main Ideas, Text Structures, and Explanatory Writing?
